reason: 2025 BMW i5 eDrive40 (RWD) not sold in Canada — Driving.ca CA lineup only lists xDrive40 AWD ($83,700) and M60 xDrive AWD ($95,700). RWD eDrive40 is US-only (US MSRP $67,100). Per pre-baked P4 (not sold in CA), skipping. The xDrive40 AWD entry covers the Canadian i5 baseline.

source.name: Driving.ca — 2025 BMW i5 Canadian lineup starts at xDrive40 AWD
